A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that

the thermal properties of the Hasteloy substrate and of the bilayer are very important for the thermal behavior of CC and that the thermal properties can be tuned in order to optimize the performance of the CC.

the propagation velocities in the CC and in YBCO film are not correlated to the thermal conductivities and that the propagation velocities of the flux flow resistivity are correlated to the thermal conductivity of the conducting bilayers.
the propagation velocities in the two systems are mainly controlled by the thermal properties of the substrate and not by the properties of the superconducting layer.
